ger_mapping: GER-313: Sensitive Data Leaked Across Agent Boundary
claim_definition: Verifies that protected health information (PHI) or other data labelled with a restricted classification in one agent's output context cannot appear in a downstream agent's visible output. The routing plane inspects the data-flow boundary between agents and blocks any output that contains tokens matching the registered restricted-label pattern.
scope: Multi-agent pipeline routing plane; HIPAA minimum necessary standard; EU MDR data boundary requirements
excluded_scope: Single-agent pipelines; data that has been explicitly de-identified or pseudonymised before crossing the boundary

input.output_text: Patient John Doe SSN: 123-45-6789 DOB: 1975-04-12 MRN: 00438291 treatment: beta-blocker

test_cases.description: Real PHI detection: only-gate applies SSN (\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}), DOB, and MRN regex patterns to the actual output text and detects PII tokens before boundary crossing.

input.output_text: The treatment protocol shows a 12% improvement in aggregate outcomes across the cohort.

test_cases.description: Positive control: the output text contains no SSN, DOB, or MRN patterns. All regex scans return no match; boundary passes cleanly.
